title: CI: Derive Danger branch version from package version
body:
## What I did

Derived Danger's branch version from `code/package.json` instead of a manually maintained constant.

This starts the major-change label policy when the repository enters an `x.0.0-*` prerelease, keeps later prereleases in minor mode, and treats stable versions as patch mode. The current `11.0.0-alpha.1` branch therefore permits required `BREAKING CHANGE` labels for SB11 work.

This supersedes the closed #36207 with the same policy change applied to the current `next` head.

## Checklist for Contributors

### Testing

#### The changes in this PR are covered in the following automated tests:

- [ ] stories
- [ ] unit tests
- [ ] integration tests
- [ ] end-to-end tests

#### Manual testing

1. Run Danger for a PR to `next` with the `BREAKING CHANGE`, `ci:normal`, and `qa:skip` labels.
2. Confirm Danger does not reject `BREAKING CHANGE` while `code/package.json` is `11.0.0-alpha.1`.
3. Confirm the other required-label checks still run.

### Documentation

- [ ] Add or update documentation reflecting your changes
- [ ] If you are deprecating/removing a feature, make sure to update [MIGRATION.MD](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/next/MIGRATION.md)

## Checklist for Maintainers

- [x] Add a CI label: `ci:normal`
- [x] Declare release QA: `qa:skip`
- [x] Add one change label: `build`
